subject: Embeddings endpoint slow after catalog rollout - action plan
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@vectorly.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-09T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Embeddings p99 spike after catalog update

Ben —

We're seeing a substantial slowdown across our embeddings calls to the hosted endpoint starting ~07:00 PDT after your team pushed the model catalog update. p95 is up ~3-4x and p99s are showing timeouts for some larger payloads. This is impacting our similarity search pipeline for production.

Quick details:
- Region: us-west1
- Endpoint: /v1/embeddings/vectorly-prod
- Typical payloads: 512 tokens, batch size 8
- Observed: p95 ~1.2s -> 4.6s, p99 > 8s with occasional 500s

Can you advise if something changed on your side and whether you can rollback or route us to a stable model? We have a major batch job starting tonight and this would break it.

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Platform Engineering — Vectorly Inc

Subject: Re: Embeddings p99 spike after catalog update

Quick findings from initial traces (attaching p95-traces-20260809.zip):
- Correlation with catalog rollout at 07:05 PDT. The new catalog variant (model-id: embed-v2-q4b) was introduced and served ~40% of traffic in round-robin.
- The new variant has a quantization profile that increases compute for longer context due to a fallback path in our runtime; that path shows significantly higher latency for batch sizes >4.
- We also saw an uptick in KV cache misses immediately after rollout (likely because cache keys differ for the new model name), causing longer cold-paths for many requests.
- No increase in 5xx error volume at infra layer — mostly timeouts at application layer.

Recommended immediate mitigations:
- Re-route production traffic back to embed-v1 for all critical routes (we can do a targeted routing rule for vectorly-prod).
- Invalidate cache priming for embed-v2 if we keep it live (but that costs tokens).
- Rollback the catalog change if re-routing is not stable.

I can execute the routing in the next 10 minutes if we get approval. ETA for routing change propagation: ~3-5 minutes.

Rishi Malhotra
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Embeddings p99 spike after catalog update

Agree with Rishi. For Vectorly specifically I recommend the following immediate action plan so their production job can proceed tonight:
- Step 1 (minutes): Apply a routing override to pin vectorly-prod -> embed-v1 for the us-west1 region only.
- Step 2 (15–30m): Monitor p95/p99 and KV cache hit rate. If stable, keep override until we finish root cause.
- Step 3 (2–6h): If we want embed-v2 live, run a controlled priming job for vectorly to pre-warm caches and measure.

Ben — can you get sign-off from Vectorly on the routing override? I'll prepare an ops runbook and coordinate with Rishi for rollback if needed.

Evelyn Hart
